item.title: Delaware Judge Rejects Paramount’s Fast-Track Bid In $82.7B Warner Bros Case
item.description: A judge in Delaware’s Chancery Court has refused to accelerate a lawsuit filed by Paramount Skydance that seeks further details from Warner Bros Discovery about how it evaluated competing takeover offers, including Netflix’s proposed deal and Paramount’s own hostile bid. The ruling is a setback for Paramount’s effort to gain greater transparency in the ongoing […]

item.title: SC Orders Tiger Global To Pay Tax On $1.6B Flipkart Sale
item.description: The Supreme Court has ruled that Tiger Global must pay capital gains tax in India on its $1.6 billion exit from Flipkart, rejecting its claim for treaty-based tax exemption and reinforcing India’s stance on offshore investment structures.

item.title: Jubilant FoodWorks Appoints Avneet Singh Puri As EVP & Head Of Operations For Domino’s India & South Asia
item.description: With over two decades of leadership experience across telecom, FMCG, and healthcare, Avneet Singh Puri has joined Jubilant FoodWorks as EVP & Head of Operations for Domino’s India and South Asia.

item.title: SPNI Announces Leadership Realignment To Advance Content-First Vision
item.description: Sony Pictures Networks India has announced a leadership realignment under a refreshed operating model to strengthen content ownership, cross-platform collaboration, and unified monetisation across linear and digital businesses.

item.title: Thums Up Rebrands Visual Identity After 2 Decades
item.description: Thums Up has refreshed its iconic logo and visual world for the first time in over two decades, signaling a shift towards a bold, contemporary, and youth-focused brand identity.

item.title: From Streets To Screens: How Brands Are Shaping Stories This Week
item.description: This week, brands across India have launched campaigns that blend creativity, cultural relevance, and social purpose from Vega Auto’s road safety awareness to Bergner and Vikas Khanna’s cookware health initiative, highlighting how storytelling and technology are being used to engage, educate, and entertain audiences across platforms.

item.title: Millennial Achievers 2025: Bhavika Jhingan Drives Marketing Impact With Ownership, Vision & Collaboration
item.description: Speaking with Marketing Mind, Bhavika Jhingan, Group Head- Content Strategy & Partnerships at Interactive Avenues and Gold winner for Account Manager of the Year at the Millennial Achievers Awards 2025, reflected on her journey, the philosophy guiding her work, and the approach that has allowed her to deliver meaningful outcomes while leading teams in India’s fast-paced advertising and marketing landscape.

item.title: KISNA Appoints Rajeev Toshniwal As Chief Financial Officer
item.description: With over two decades of experience across retail, FMCG, and apparel businesses, Rajeev Toshniwal has joined KISNA Diamond and Gold Jewellery as Chief Financial Officer.
